newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson wins 1.1 bln Skr order for Amazon radar.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson wins 1.1 bln Skr order for Amazon radar.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Monday its unit Microwave Systems won an order worth 1.1 billion crowns for radar systems in the Amazon region, Brazil.
Delivery will start in 1999 for installation in the new Brazilian Embraer EMB 145 aircraft, Ericsson said in a statement.
In the Amazons, the system will mainly be used for the surveillance of suspected drug shipments, the company said.
"This is Ericsson's first export order of the Erieye AWE&C (Airborne Early Warning and Control) system, currently in series production for the Swedish air force," the company said.
"It is also the company's single largest order in the defence electronics area."
Erieye has attracted great international interest, Ericsson said, adding that discussions are currently going on with a number of countries in Europe, Asia and Latin America.
The system is the first long-range high-performance AEW&C system that can be installed in relatively small commercial and military turbo-prop aircraft, the company said.
